description: Smart Growth Fixes for Climate Adaptation and Resilience is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Office of Sustainable Communities, Smart Growth Program. This document can help governments identify policy strategies that can save lives, protect property, and strengthen their economies by adapting to climate change. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
